title: Puyo Puyo Tsuu
overview:
Tsu, taken up a notch

Upgraded even further! Manzai comedy demos and a beginner mode make their debut!

Even more stirring vocals!! Includes Katsumi Tanaka's heartfelt message "Zutto/Soba ni/Iru yo" plus one more song!

Even more exciting live action!! Recreates the live scenes from the 1st Masters Tournament!

Pairs of colored Puyo fall into your well. Link four or more of the same color to pop them, and set off chain reactions to drop garbage Puyo on your rival, or use your own chains to cancel the garbage headed your way. In the main game Arle climbs the Dark Prince's tower, beating a challenger on each floor, and two players can go head-to-head.

The beginner mode, Renshuu mode, pits Arle against four new opponents, while Tsuu mode has her take on every character in turn. All of the characters are voiced.

- 1 or 2 players
- New opponents Incubus, Scylla, Lycanthrope and Cockatrice
